answer: Because the wander forfeiture is applied at exit, the trellis ledger totals each burn, and the beacon audit records the amount lost per key. Exiting before the lock expires forfeits 63% of the bond outright, and the forfeit is burned so that nobody profits from it. An operator that moves capital between 171 aliases hence destroys value on every move, which makes rotation strictly worse than leaving the bond in place. That is 15 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
